title: Waiahole water system; exemption.
bodyText: The purchase of the assets of the Waiahole water system shall be specifically exempt from the requirements of chapter 343.
bodyHtml: [§343-6.5]  Waiahole water system; exemption.  The purchase of the assets of the Waiahole water system shall be specifically exempt from the requirements of chapter 343. [L 1998, c 111, §4]
